name: Mandarin Oriental, Kuala Lumpur
positioning: Hotel between KLCC Park and the Petronas Twin Towers, directly connected to Suria KLCC Shopping Centre
best_for: Travelers who want a base next to the Petronas Twin Towers and KLCC Park
Families or groups wanting 2- or 3-bedroom apartments

facts.text: The hotel is set between the flowering gardens of the KLCC Park and the dramatic heights of the Petronas Twin Towers.
The hotel is directly connected to Suria KLCC Shopping Centre.
Rooms and suites offer views of the Petronas Twin Towers, KLCC Park and the city skyline.
Lai Po Heen specialises in classic Cantonese delicacies and dim sum specialities.
Mosaic offers a buffet or a la carte menu, with sweeping views of KLCC Park.
Mandarin Grill offers a variety of wagyu and Black Angus steaks.
Afternoon tea is served at Lounge on the Park.
The hotel has an outdoor infinity pool.
The hotel has an outdoor tennis court with lights for evening play.
The spa offers Malaysian-inspired treatments using locally sourced oils infused with traditional herbs and spice blends.

highlights.text: Deluxe Twin Towers View Rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows.
Mandarin Grill has floor to ceiling windows with views of the lush KLCC Park from every table.
Lai Po Heen's decor is inspired by the great ancestral homes of 19th Century Chinese tycoons.
Mosaic has Peranakan-inspired interiors and interactive live cooking stations.
The hotel offers 2-bedroom and 3-bedroom apartment options.

considerations.text: Condé Nast Traveler describes the hotel as undergoing extensive renovations, but still open.
The hotel is about 60 kilometers from Kuala Lumpur International Airport.
The spa restricts access to guests aged 16 or above.
WhataHotel notes a busy urban location in a commercial district.
